SAND_GENERATOR_11 }} A '''Sand Minion''' is a {{Skill|Mining}} [[Minions|Minion]] that generates and collects {{Item|Sand}}. '''Sand Minion''' recipes are unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Sand|1}}. == Usage == === Drops === {{Minion Drops Table}} === Stats === {{MinionStatsTable}} === Layouts === ==== Ideal Layout ==== {{Minion ideal layout|minion=Sand Minion|ideal=Air (minion)}} Due to {{Item|Sand}} being affected by gravity, there needs to be a block under the air to keep the sand in reach. ==== Special Layouts ==== A '''Sand Minion''' can be made almost twice as fast by letting the sand fall on a non-full block (like {{Item|Sign}}s or {{Item|Carpet}}) above a {{Item|Hopper}}. The non-full block breaks the falling sand and hoppers underneath can collect it. This will cause the minion to skip the mining action, but that does make the minion {{Red|10%}} slower{{ConfirmationNeeded}}, so it is almost twice as fast. Special layouts only work when the {{Zone|Private Island}} is loaded. === Minion Modifiers === {{Minion Modifiers List|mining}} == Obtaining == {{MinionRecipesTable}} == Trivia == * Despite being a display in {{NPCSprite|Bulvar}}'s shop, you cannot acquire a Tier XII Sand Minion from them. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.1|[[File:Sand Minion.png|26px]] Added Tier I-XI '''Sand Minion'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Sand}} {{Nav/Minions}} [[Category:Mining]] [[Category:Pages with UIs]]
